Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

This dispute concerns the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged to the rider after the driver cancelled trip TRP-02724 at 21:27:08 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The rider is refunded the whole SGD 4.50, and no driver compensation is payable.

How to appeal: POL-GEN-04. Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

This dispute concerns the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged to the rider after the driver cancelled trip TRP-02724 at 21:27:08 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The rider is refunded the whole SGD 4.50, and no driver compensation is payable. Driver — most of your account is accepted. Your GPS trace (EV-GPS-02724, weight 1.0) places you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 21:23:45, the timestamp of your 'I'm Here' tap, and holds you there for a continuous run of 21 qualifying fixes lasting 200 seconds — longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, EV-TRIP-02724). Your arrival marker was not false: the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the arrival event (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so POL-NS-05 does not recompute the waiting clock and no false-arrival referral attaches. But none of that decides the fee. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: limb (d) requires termination for RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE — as you acknowledge — is none of them; the clause names it as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider. Your claim for the SGD 3.60 net figure under POL-NS-07 therefore fails: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full or POL-NS-10(g) applies, and neither condition holds.
